21 hours in 90 seconds👨🏽‍🌾 ⚠️Flash Warning⚠️ This house was bought near the end of 2025 and the garden was a right state!  I was called in to replace the fence panels and totally rip out the garden  (not the posts, they are a bit crooked but they are still standing😅)  I started with the fence panels, then began to totally clear the area of weeds and any other debris in the garden.  We added 2 railway sleepers at the back for a little flower bed. Then a thick layer of top soil was spread and we rolled out the turf. Then we moved 4 tonnes of hardcore to the back through the house!  Backbreaking stuff.  Thanks to my pal @Wagwarn Abel for jumping on and giving me a hand 🙏 This is obviously unfinished but I think the owner was going to slab the rest himself, so our job is done here for now! As always I wanna know what would YOU do now? There's a bed at the back that's totally empty!  I read and appreciate any comments and genuinely like reading your suggestions🙏 Thanks so much for watching anyway, follow if you haven't already for more vids like this!! 🌾 The Mowable Meadow The mowable meadow is one of our flagship services — and one of the most powerful ways we help reprogram the American lawn back into the American meadow. It’s a thoughtful transition that blends familiarity with ecological function. With a mowable meadow, we selectively mow pathways and borders, creating structure and intention, while leaving other areas untouched. This approach allows flowering plants to thrive, increases pollinator habitat, and brings a level of biodiversity and beauty you simply won’t find in a traditional lawn. It’s time to rethink how we manage our landscapes. It’s time to Mow Different. #GreenAbundanceByDesign #EcologicalLandscaping #MowableMeadow #SuburbanMeadow #stewardship

Five plants that separate a designed garden from a planted one. Rosemary — most people treat it as a herb. Designers use it as a structural evergreen with silver foliage, late winter bloom, and serious drought tolerance once established. Echinops — steel-blue globe thistle that holds its form into winter. Pollinators love it, it seeds around just enough, and nothing else gives you that texture. White Cloud Nepeta — all the soft billowing habit of catmint, none of the blue. Cleaner in a white or silver palette. Underused because most people don’t know it exists. Mountain Hydrangea (Hydrangea serrata) — more refined than arborescens, lacecap form, better fall color, and it actually performs in part shade without flopping. Blue Mist Fothergilla (Fothergilla gardenii ‘Blue Mist’) — blue-green foliage all season, then flame in fall. Native, compact, and genuinely beautiful. The plant that makes clients ask “what is that?” #gardendesign #landscapedesign

⚠️ To everyone in the 559 area, please be cautious when hiring Premier Landscape. Unfortunately, our experience with this contractor has been extremely disappointing. We had such high expectations, especially considering this was a $140,000 backyard project. Throughout the entire process, we made every single payment on time. Not once did we delay a payment. If anything, we were extremely patient and understanding with the constant delays, many of which were not related to city inspections but rather the contractor’s inability to get the work completed as scheduled. Fast-forward to today, and we’re still left with unfinished work, an incomplete waterfall, concrete with significant issues, and a pool that has STILL not passed its final inspection. What’s even more frustrating is the lack of communication. Our calls and messages have gone unanswered, and we’ve now discovered that the contractor has blocked us on social media. At this point, we’re genuinely concerned that he has no intention of returning to finish our project. It’s extremely upsetting because we worked hard to afford this backyard, trusted this company with our home, and held up our end of the agreement every step of the way. We paid for a completed $140,000 project, and that’s not what we’ve received. I’m sharing our personal experience because I wouldn’t want another family to go through the same frustration, stress, and disappointment we’ve experienced. Please do your research, ask questions, and be extremely careful before trusting someone with such a large investment. 💔#559 #scam #fyp #viral #pool
